content: All systems are looking good, and weather is favorable for liftoff. Propellant load is about to begin for Falcon 9’s launch of the USSF-432 mission from California → https://spacex.com/launches/ussf432

Some new data from Anthropic looking at the impact of AI on the sciences by field: "With current capabilities, if adopted widely, AI could take on 27–52% of the researcher time needed to produce a new study, with a median of 38% across fields..." Here: https://www.anthropic.com/research/how-researchers-use-claude
"These shares imply research accelerations ranging from 1.35x in the arts, 1.36x in anthropology, and 1.41x in chemistry to 1.96x in computer science and 2.02x in statistics,"
